de: Lokales Unwetter sorgte für massive Schäden. Am Samstag ist ein heftiges Unwetter über Steinabrunn (Bezirk Korneuburg) gezogen und hat dabei massive Schäden angerichtet. Dächer wurden abgedeckt, Bäume entwurzelt. Laut ORF-Wetterredaktion handelte es sich um einen sogenannten Downburst.
en: Local storms caused massive damage. On Saturday, a violent storm hit Steinabrunn (Korneuburg district) and caused massive damage. Roofs were covered and trees were uprooted. According to the ORF weather editorial team, it was a so-called downburst.
la: Tempestates locales magnum damnum effecit. Die Sabbati vehemens tempestas Steinabrunn (Korneuburg regio) et magnum damnum intulit. Tecta erant tecta et arbores evulsae sunt. Secundum tempestatem ORF editorial team, sic dictus downburst fuit.

en: Severe storms in Germany: tree falls on car - extended family was "very lucky". Violent thunderstorms with heavy rain and hurricane force winds are moving through parts of Germany. But most of them still get off lightly. A large family is also lucky when their car becomes trapped under a treetop.
la: Gravissimae tempestates in Germania: arbor in autocinetum cadit - familia extensa erat "valde felix". Tonitruum violentum cum gravibus pluviis et vi ventorum per partes Germaniae moventur. Sed plerique tamen leviter dimittunt. Magna familia etiam felix est cum currus eorum sub arbore capitur.
